title: Appeal 24296 (reconsideration): seismic upgrade omitted for a change from residential to business occupancy (City Code 24.85.060)
jurisdiction: City of Portland, Oregon (USA), Bureau of Development Services Administrative Appeal Board; non-Alberta comparative record

facts.text: Appeal item: City Code 24.85.060 says a change of occupancy or use may require a seismic upgrade; the request is for an omission of the seismic upgrade for a change from R to B/M occupancy.
The applicant says a 1965 permit changed the occupancy from R-3 to B, but no final completion record was found in city records.
Decision: omission of seismic upgrades is granted as proposed.
